about: What bench/bench.py runs, all provisional until the first runs on the real path. Each CPU limit is a resource profile, named by it, with no memory limit (bench/plan-autopilot.json shows profiles with memory limits). Each case runs under every CPU limit it has a rate for, as one oha process per request of bench/requests.json at its weight's share of the rate and of the connections. Requests scheduled in the first ramp_s seconds (while connections open) are not counted, nor those after duration_s more; tail_s more seconds let the last counted requests finish. A case may set its own duration_s and rss_interval_s. idle_connections are opened to the plain port before the load, each sends one request, and they stay open, idle, until the load ends. idle_rss is smock's RSS settle_s seconds after it is ready, before any load, under each profile it names, whichever profiles a run selects (without profiles, under each profile the run selects). The targets, in bench/targets.json, hold under the profiles of bench/plan-autopilot.json, with their memory limits: a run of this plan reports each as not measured.
